entries.affected: 13 crusts x 4 smooth tokens x RG_SLY4 = 52 cases observed NATIVE_REJECTED. RG_KDE0v1 was observed with beta_equilibrated=False at read time (same guard), but its matching was NOT_RUN. 156 of 390 historical tasks use an RG_* core.
entries.what: Native match-core rejects RG_SLY4 with 'native matching requires beta-equilibrated inputs'. Fortran reader sets beta_equilibrated = max|Q5|<1e-8 (compose_eos_io.f90:354); the RG_SLY4 source has constant Q5=0.001383223 on all 197 rows. Legacy matching never checked Q5 and the frozen outputs set Q5=0.
entries.not_done: Guard not relaxed and Q5 not reinterpreted: the meaning of the constant Q5 offset in RG sources needs a source-semantics decision (provider/paper), not a tolerance change.
